method: Actual HALC controller, actual bundled MapLibre Style state APIs and paint compiler/evaluator, deterministic source-state cache and DOM interfaces. No browser tile/GPU/memory claim.

benchmark.note: Local Node fixture operation counts; timings include different work and are not a browser speed comparison. Source workers/GPU absent.

results.name: Source promotes the complete source fid across every tile fragment
Both selected line passes remain above regional outlines before and after source recreation
Independent selection is fully opaque at regional scale without dimming ordinary line hierarchy
Opening a locality sets one exact state target without source reload
Changing selection removes only its old key and keeps unrelated state
Closing the native popup clears the highlight and public selection token
Full IDs near the source maximum never select a prefix or truncated ID
Malformed IDs cannot disturb the current selection or start a detail request
Fast switching rejects late dossier responses without resurrecting old highlight
A pan with incomplete tiles preserves selected identity and its dossier
An offscreen selected fid remains keyed for newly arrived tile fragments
Leaving year clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Leaving mode clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Leaving modern reference clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Leaving borders clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Leaving zoom clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Leaving coverage clears feature-state and ignores the late dossier
Main source error removes its selection state; late readiness cannot restore it
Recreating the main source drops old state and a fresh selection targets the new source
A region-only failure preserves the local selection and does not reload locality source
Restoring a URL selection waits for a rendered eligible source
Destroy clears only owned state before map teardown and ignores late callbacks
Two comparison maps keep independent selection state
Actual bundled style requires 200 reloads for alternating old filters and zero for state selection
